newsitem.title: JAPAN: TEPCO electricity output hits winter high.
newsitem.headline: TEPCO electricity output hits winter high.

text.p: Tokyo Electric Power Co Inc, Japan's largest power utility, said on Thursday its electricity output hit a record high for winter of 48.50 million kilowatts (kw) at 6.00 p.m. (0900 GMT) on Wednesday.
Chilly temperatures of 3.2 degrees celsius at that time made residents in the Tokyo region turn their heating facilities up, it said.
TEPCO's previous record for winter electricity output was 47.95 million kw on February 2, 1996.
Use of electricity is greater during the summer months.
TEPCO's all time high is 59.40 million kw, marked on July 18, 1996.
